annotations.title: Add a note to a thread

description: Leaves a note on a thread for the team, 1 to 10,000 characters. A note is stored with the thread and never sent: nobody on the thread sees it. A thread holds up to 500 notes, and past that the call is refused (`resource_cap_exceeded`). A test key cannot add one to a thread that holds live mail. Returns the note.

body.description: The note, 1 to 10,000 characters. Only your team sees it: it is never sent, quoted in a reply or forward, or put in an event.

name: mails_add_thread_note
